name: Star Rating (Interactive)
summary: Native radio group for choosing one integer rating from one through five.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native fieldset or equivalent radio-group boundary for one rating question.

anatomy.name: legend
anatomy.description: Visible group question, preferably rendered as the fieldset legend.

anatomy.name: choice
anatomy.description: Repeated touch-sized native label for one integer rating choice.

anatomy.name: radio
anatomy.description: Visually hidden native radio that retains focus, keyboard, validation, reset, and form-submission behavior.

anatomy.name: indicator
anatomy.description: Optional decorative star icon inside a choice label.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible question describing what the one-through-five choices rate.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Shared native form name applied to every radio in the group.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Currently selected integer rating; each radio retains its own corresponding native value.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Requires one native radio choice before its containing form can submit.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes every native radio choice unavailable.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: ID reference to supporting or validation feedback owned by the containing form composition.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default 28px star icon inside the existing touch-target token.

states.name: default
states.description: Available rating group with no pointer preview.

states.name: checked
states.description: Native selected value and the lower visual values shown as filled.

states.name: hover
states.description: Fine-pointer preview of a candidate value and lower values.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Visible focus indicator projected from the focused native radio onto its label.

behavior.name: nativeSelection
behavior.description: Five native radios share one name and retain browser selection, arrow-key movement, validation, form reset, and submission semantics.

behavior.name: choiceLabels
behavior.description: Each choice has a readable label such as 4 stars; the decorative indicator does not replace that name.

accessibility: Use one native radio group with a visible legend or equivalent group label.
Give every radio a readable choice label such as 1 star or 5 stars.
Preserve native keyboard selection, validation, form reset, and submission behavior.
Keep the native radio focusable and project focus-visible styling onto the touch-sized label.
Use Star Rating instead when the value is read-only.

web.notes: Native radio focus, checked, disabled, touch, and reduced-motion presentation is implemented in components/css/reviews.css.

shopify.notes: Submission transport and provider mapping remain outside the Star Input contract.
